import os, signal, subprocess, time
inner='source scripts/source_idf.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; exec python -m esp_idf_monitor --port /dev/cu.usbserial-1130 --baud 115200 --no-reset --disable-address-decoding'
cmd=['script','-q','/dev/null','bash','-lc',inner]
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, start_new_session=True)
time.sleep(3)
p.stdin.write('status\n'); p.stdin.flush(); time.sleep(3)
p.stdin.write('sensors\n'); p.stdin.flush(); time.sleep(7)
p.stdin.write('sensors\n'); p.stdin.flush(); time.sleep(3)
os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
try:
    out,_=p.communicate(timeout=5)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL); out,_=p.communicate()
print('MONITOR_OUTPUT_BEGIN')
for line in out.splitlines():
    low=line.lower()
    if ('status firmware_sha=' in low or 'scd41 ' in low or 'rtc sampled=' in low or 'esp-rom:esp32s3' in low or 'rst:0x' in low or 'esp-idf-monitor' in low): print(line)
print('MONITOR_OUTPUT_END')
print('ROM_BOOT_MARKER', 'ESP-ROM:esp32s3' in out)
PY
